claim: The order-11 orientation rotation cannot act faithfully on the ordinary genus-two level-2 carrier or lift as finite order in Sp(4,Z); the exact common finite carrier is instead the CRT product Sp(4,F2) x Sp(4,F23) at congruence level 46.

level2.consequence: the C11 rotation cannot act nontrivially on the ten even-characteristic orbit

integral.consequence: every homomorphism D11 -> Sp(4,Z) kills C11 and factors through at most C2

crtCarrier.groupFactorization: Sp(4,Z/46Z) is isomorphic to Sp(4,F2) x Sp(4,F23)
crtCarrier.level2Role: ten even theta characteristics and seam parity
crtCarrier.level23Role: Dic11 twist-charge orientation skeleton embedded through SL(2,23)
crtCarrier.centralSign: -I is identity in the F2 factor and nontrivial in the F23 factor

candidate.type: vector-valued genus-two modular form or defect kernel K_(delta,lambda)(Omega)
candidate.boundaryInputs: at most eight order-46 centralizer-augmented Galois-oriented traces
candidate.success: a non-factorized kernel has compatible level-2 multipliers, level-23 transition action and separating degeneration
candidate.failure: no candidate reproduces the bounded order-46 boundary traces with compatible multipliers

analyticBoundary.warning: the possible finer levels are an analytic search range, not a proved minimal level

physicalBoundary: the CRT carrier is an arithmetic interface; it does not select real Spin(2,3) signature, positive energy, time orientation, dynamics or a detector
